newsitem.title: USA: Manchester sees lower 97 net vs pro forma.
newsitem.headline: Manchester sees lower 97 net vs pro forma.

text.p: Manchester Equipment Co Inc said Tuesday it expects net income for fiscal 1997 to be about 10 percent below that of fiscal 1996 pro-forma net income.
Barry Steinberg, president and chief executive, said the company also expects revenues for the next two quarters, not including acquisitions, to be slightly under last year's second-half results.
Steinberg made the statement as the company released its fiscal second quarter results, showing net income a share at $0.10, down from $0.15 in the comparable period a year ago.

Steinberg said the company's expectations are due to a variety of reasons, including lower than anticipated customer orders in its second quarter and the timing and expenses associated with implementation of its growth strategy.
Steinberg said that the second quarter results are consistent with the estimates released by the company in February.
